1.title: The Leader
1.summary: Independence, leadership, originality. Natural initiator who turns ideas into reality through willpower and self-direction.

2.title: The Diplomat
2.summary: Cooperation, diplomacy, sensitivity. Thrives on partnership, harmony, and reading what others need.

3.title: The Communicator
3.summary: Creativity, self-expression, social skill. Translates feelings into words, art, or performance; prone to scattered energy if unfocused.

4.title: The Builder
4.summary: Stability, organization, practicality. Builds things that last through steady, methodical work; shows care through action.

5.title: The Adventurer
5.summary: Freedom, adventure, adaptability. Craves variety and change; life purpose often involves full experience and inspiring others through it.

6.title: The Nurturer
6.summary: Responsibility, nurturing, harmony. Natural caregiver drawn to family, community, and restoring balance.

7.title: The Seeker
7.summary: Analysis, introspection, spirituality. Analytical mind drawn to research, solitude, and deeper truth.

8.title: The Powerhouse
8.summary: Ambition, authority, material success. Driven toward achievement, business, and tangible results.

9.title: The Humanitarian
9.summary: Compassion, wisdom, humanitarianism. Oriented toward service to others and the collective good.

11.title: The Intuitive (Master Number)
11.summary: Heightened idealism, intuition, and sensitivity. Not reduced further; carries the themes of 2 at a more intense, spiritually-charged level.

22.title: The Master Builder (Master Number)
22.summary: Large-scale vision paired with practical execution. Carries the themes of 4 at a more intense level, able to turn big ideas into lasting structures.

33.title: The Master Teacher (Master Number)
33.summary: Selfless service and compassion at a heightened level. Carries the themes of 6, focused on healing and uplifting others.

compatibilityGroups.note: Basic grouping heuristic (not a precise science) used by the Compatibility feature: same group = harmonious, different group = neutral, identical Life Path = strong-match.

chaldeanSystem.note: Older numerology system, does not use the number 9 in its letter mapping. Offered as an alternative to Pythagorean via a system toggle.
